local function makePart(parent, name, size, color, cf, anchored)

local function weld(a, b, offset)

end

local function weaponPose(s)
	if not s.Grip or not s.Grip.Parent then return end
	local torso = s.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or s.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or s.Root
	local left = s.Character:FindFirstChild("LeftHand") or s.Character:FindFirstChild("Left Arm") or torso
	local right = s.Character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or s.Character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or torso
	if s.Drawn then
		s.Grip.Part0 = if s.WeaponId == "Bow" then left else right
		s.RestPose = if s.WeaponId == "Bow" then CFrame.new(0, .1, -.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, -math.pi/2, 0)
			else CFrame.new(0, -.5, -.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-25), 0, math.rad(10))
	else
		s.Grip.Part0 = torso
		s.RestPose = CFrame.new(.5, -1, 1) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-30))
	end
	s.Grip.C0 = s.RestPose
	if s.OffGrip then
		s.OffGrip.Part0 = if s.Drawn then left else torso
		s.OffRest = if s.Drawn then CFrame.new(0, -.3, -.35) else CFrame.new(-.7, -.7, 1.3)
		s.OffGrip.C0 = if s.Blocking then CFrame.new(.5,.5,-1) * CFrame.Angles(0,-.3,0) else s.OffRest
	end
	if s.SheathGrip then s.SheathGrip.Part0 = torso; s.SheathGrip.C0 = CFrame.new(.5,-1,1.04)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-30)) end
end

local function createWeapon(s)
	if s.WeaponModel then s.WeaponModel:Destroy() end
	s.OffGrip = nil; s.SheathGrip = nil
	local model = weaponTemplates[s.WeaponId]:Clone(); model.Name = "TrainingWeapon"
	for _, assembly in model:GetChildren() do
		local handle = assembly.PrimaryPart
		for _, p in assembly:GetChildren() do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				p.Anchored = false; p.CanCollide = false; p.CanQuery = false; p.Massless = true
				if p ~= handle and not p:FindFirstChild("KatanaWeld") and not p:FindFirstChild("WeaponProWeld") then weld(handle,p,handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)) end
			end
		end
		local grip = weld(s.Root,handle,CFrame.new())
		if assembly.Name == "Main" then s.Grip = grip elseif assembly.Name == "Offhand" then s.OffGrip = grip else s.SheathGrip = grip end
	end
	model.Parent = s.Character; s.WeaponModel = model; weaponPose(s)
end

local function hit(s, dummy, damage, isPet)
	if not dummy:IsDescendantOf(dummies) then return end
	local hp = dummy:GetAttribute("Health")
	local applied = math.min(hp, damage)
	hp -= applied
	if isPet then s.PetDamage += applied else s.Damage += applied end
	-- Đây là hình nộm vô hạn, làm đầy lại khi bị hạ; không phát thưởng.
	dummy:SetAttribute("Health", if hp <= 0 then Config.DummyHealth else hp)
	updateDummy(dummy)
	remote:FireAllClients("Hit", dummy.Target.Position, applied, isPet)
	sync(s)
end
local function directionOK(v, ranged)
	return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.X == v.X and v.Y == v.Y and v.Z == v.Z
		and math.abs(v.X) < 2 and math.abs(v.Z) < 2 and math.abs(v.Y) < (if ranged then 2 else .01) and v.Magnitude > 0.5
end
local function lineOfSight(s, pos, dummy)
	local params = RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {s.Character, pets}
	local result = workspace:Raycast(s.Root.Position, pos - s.Root.Position, params)
	return not result or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(dummy)
end
local function startPetAttack(s, target)
	local animator = s.PetAnimator
	if not animator or animator:IsAttacking() then return end
	s.PetTarget = target
	local count = animator:GetHitCount()
	animator.OnHit = function(index)
		if not alive(s) or states[s.Player] ~= s or not s.InTraining or s.PetTarget ~= target
			or s.LastTarget ~= target or not target:IsDescendantOf(dummies)
			or os.clock() >= (s.TargetUntil or 0) then return end
		local point = target.Target.Position
		local center = s.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {s.Character, pets}
		local obstruction = workspace:Raycast(center, point - center, params)
		if (center - point).Magnitude > 7 or (s.Root.Position - point).Magnitude >= 18
			or (obstruction and not obstruction.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target)) then return end
		-- Split the original total damage across the two dagger strikes.
		local amount = math.floor(Config.PetDamage / count)
			+ (if index <= Config.PetDamage % count then 1 else 0)
		hit(s, target, amount, true)
		if s.PetWeaponId == "Bow" then remote:FireAllClients("Shot", center, point, false) end
	end
	if animator:Attack() then
		s.PetClock = os.clock() + Config.PetInterval
		s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetAttackStarted", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetAttackSequence", s.Pet:GetAttribute("PetAttackSequence") + 1)
	end
end
local function attack(s, action, direction, releasedKind, releasedSpec)
	local weapon=Weapons[s.WeaponId]
	if not (s.InTraining or s.InHunting) or not directionOK(direction,weapon.Ranged) then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local kind,spec=releasedKind,releasedSpec
	if not kind then kind,spec=Rules.attack(Config,Weapons,s,action,now) end
	if not kind then return end
	local attackDamage=spec.Damage*(if economy then economy:DamageMultiplier(s.Player,s.WeaponId) else 1)
	direction = direction.Unit
	local flat=Vector3.new(direction.X,0,direction.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude>.01 then s.Root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(s.Root.Position, s.Root.Position + flat) end
	s.Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	local character = s.Character
	local boosted=weapon.Ranged and now<s.BowBoostUntil
	if weapon.Ranged then s.BowBoostUntil=0 end
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackStarted", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackDuration", spec.Duration)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackWindup", spec.Windup)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackHits", (if weapon.Ranged then spec.Shots else spec.Hits) or 1)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackHitInterval", (if weapon.Ranged then spec.ShotInterval else spec.HitInterval) or (if weapon.Ranged then (if s.InHunting then .09 else 0) else 0.13))
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackSequence", (s.WeaponModel:GetAttribute("WeaponAttackSequence") or 0) + 1)
	remote:FireClient(s.Player, "Attack", kind, spec.Name, spec.Duration)
	-- A serial prevents a late recovery callback from overwriting the next strike.
	s.AttackSerial=(s.AttackSerial or 0)+1; local serial=s.AttackSerial
	local attackToken=tostring(s.Player.UserId)..":"..string.format("%.6f",workspace:GetServerTimeNow())..":"..serial
	local function forestHit(applied,point)
		if applied>0 then
			s.HuntEngagedUntil = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + 25
			s.Player:SetAttribute("HuntingDamage",(s.Player:GetAttribute("HuntingDamage") or 0)+applied)
			remote:FireAllClients("Hit",point,applied,false)
		end
	end
	local windup = s.RestPose * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(100), 0, math.rad(-30))
	if spec.Style=="Thrust" then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,.7)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
	elseif spec.Style=="Spin" or spec.Style=="Sweep" then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(0,-1.4,math.pi/2) end
	if weapon.Ranged then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,.25) end
	TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(spec.Windup), {C0 = windup}):Play()
	task.delay(spec.Windup, function()
		if not alive(s) or s.Character ~= character or states[s.Player] ~= s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
		if weapon.Ranged then
			TweenService:Create(s.Grip,TweenInfo.new(.16),{C0=s.RestPose}):Play()
			local params=RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances={s.Character,pets}
			for i=1,spec.Shots or 1 do
				if i>1 and (spec.ShotInterval or s.InHunting) then task.wait(spec.ShotInterval or .09) end
				if not alive(s) or s.Character~=character or states[s.Player]~=s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
				local origin=s.Root.Position+Vector3.new(0,.8,0)
				local angle=math.rad(math.ceil((i-1)/2)*(if i%2==0 then -1 else 1)*(spec.Spread or 4))
				local aim=CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis,angle):VectorToWorldSpace(direction)
				local result=workspace:Raycast(origin,aim*spec.Range,params)
				local endpoint=if result then result.Position else origin+aim*spec.Range
				remote:FireAllClients("Shot",origin,endpoint,boosted and i==1)
				if result then
					if s.InHunting and dinosaurCombat:FromRayHit(result.Instance) then
						local amount=math.floor(spec.Damage*(if boosted and i==1 then 1.25 else 1)+.5)
						if dinosaurCombat:CanHit(s.Player,result.Position,spec.Range+2) then
							forestHit(dinosaurCombat:Damage(s.Player,amount,result.Position,attackToken..":arrow:"..i),result.Position)
						end
					end
					for _,dummy in dummies:GetChildren() do if s.InTraining and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(dummy) then
						hit(s,dummy,math.floor(spec.Damage*(if boosted and i==1 then 1.25 else 1)+.5),false); s.LastTarget=dummy; s.TargetUntil=os.clock()+12
						break

			end

		end
		for n=1,spec.Hits or 1 do
			if n>1 then task.wait(spec.HitInterval or .13) end
			if not alive(s) or s.Character~=character or states[s.Player]~=s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
			local pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-95),0,if n%2==0 then -.4 else .4)
			if spec.Style=="Thrust" then pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,-2)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
			elseif spec.Style=="Spin" or spec.Style=="Sweep" then pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(0,if n%2==0 then -1.5 else 1.5,math.pi/2) end
			TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(.1), {C0=pose}):Play()
			if spec.Style=="Shield" and s.OffGrip then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.1),{C0=s.OffRest*CFrame.new(.4,.3,-1.2)}):Play() end
			if spec.Name then remote:FireAllClients("ComboFX",s.Root.CFrame,spec.Style,spec.Range) end
			if s.OffGrip and s.WeaponId=="DualDaggers" then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.1),{C0=s.OffRest*CFrame.Angles(-1.5,0,if n%2==0 then .4 else -.4)}):Play() end
			if s.InHunting then
				local applied,point=dinosaurCombat:MeleeStrike(s.Player,s.Root.Position+Vector3.new(0,.8,0),direction,
					spec.Range,spec.Arc or .3,attackDamage,attackToken..":melee:"..n)
				if applied>0 then forestHit(applied,point) end
			end
			for _, dummy in dummies:GetChildren() do
				local delta = dummy.Target.Position - s.Root.Position
				local targetFlat = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
				if s.InTraining and delta.Magnitude <= spec.Range and targetFlat.Magnitude > 0 and direction:Dot(targetFlat.Unit) >= (spec.Arc or .3)
					and lineOfSight(s, dummy.Target.Position, dummy) then
					hit(s, dummy, attackDamage, false); s.LastTarget = dummy; s.TargetUntil = now + 12
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	task.delay(spec.Duration, function()
		if states[s.Player] ~= s or not alive(s) or s.Character ~= character or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
		TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {C0 = s.RestPose}):Play()
		if s.OffGrip then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.12),{C0=s.OffRest}):Play() end
		s.Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	end)
	sync(s)
end

local function createWeapon(s)

local function updateDummy(dummy)

local function hit(s, dummy, damage, isPet)
	if not dummy:IsDescendantOf(dummies) then return end
	local hp = dummy:GetAttribute("Health")
	local applied = math.min(hp, damage)
	hp -= applied
	if isPet then s.PetDamage += applied else s.Damage += applied end
	-- Đây là hình nộm vô hạn, làm đầy lại khi bị hạ; không phát thưởng.
	dummy:SetAttribute("Health", if hp <= 0 then Config.DummyHealth else hp)

	remote:FireAllClients("Hit", dummy.Target.Position, applied, isPet)

local function directionOK(v, ranged)
	return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.X == v.X and v.Y == v.Y and v.Z == v.Z
		and math.abs(v.X) < 2 and math.abs(v.Z) < 2 and math.abs(v.Y) < (if ranged then 2 else .01) and v.Magnitude > 0.5
end
local function lineOfSight(s, pos, dummy)
	local params = RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {s.Character, pets}
	local result = workspace:Raycast(s.Root.Position, pos - s.Root.Position, params)
	return not result or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(dummy)
end
local function readBowAim(s, value)

	if not directionOK(direction, true) then return nil end
	local target = if typeof(value)=="table" and Bow.validTarget(value.Target, Bow.origin(s.Root.Position)) then value.Target else nil

end
local function startPetAttack(s, target)
	local animator = s.PetAnimator

	animator.OnHit = function(index)
		if not alive(s) or states[s.Player] ~= s or not s.InTraining or s.PetTarget ~= target
			or s.LastTarget ~= target or not target:IsDescendantOf(dummies)
			or os.clock() >= (s.TargetUntil or 0) then return end
		local point = target.Target.Position
		local center = s.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {s.Character, pets}
		local obstruction = workspace:Raycast(center, point - center, params)
		if (center - point).Magnitude > 7 or (s.Root.Position - point).Magnitude >= 18
			or (obstruction and not obstruction.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target)) then return end

local function attack(s, action, direction, releasedKind, releasedSpec, targetPoint)
	local weapon=Weapons[s.WeaponId]
	if not (s.InTraining or s.InHunting) or not directionOK(direction,weapon.Ranged) then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local kind,spec=releasedKind,releasedSpec
	if not kind then kind,spec=Rules.attack(Config,Weapons,s,action,now) end
	if not kind then return end
	local attackDamage=spec.Damage*(if economy then economy:DamageMultiplier(s.Player,s.WeaponId) else 1)
	direction = direction.Unit
	local flat=Vector3.new(direction.X,0,direction.Z)
	if not weapon.Ranged and flat.Magnitude>.01 then s.Root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(s.Root.Position, s.Root.Position + flat) end
	s.Humanoid.AutoRotate = if weapon.Ranged then not s.Aiming else false
	local character = s.Character
	local boosted=weapon.Ranged and now<s.BowBoostUntil
	if weapon.Ranged then s.BowBoostUntil=0 end
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackStarted", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackDuration", spec.Duration)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackWindup", spec.Windup)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackHits", (if weapon.Ranged then spec.Shots else spec.Hits) or 1)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackHitInterval", (if weapon.Ranged then spec.ShotInterval else spec.HitInterval) or (if weapon.Ranged then (if s.InHunting then .09 else 0) else 0.13))
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackSequence", (s.WeaponModel:GetAttribute("WeaponAttackSequence") or 0) + 1)
	remote:FireClient(s.Player, "Attack", kind, spec.Name, spec.Duration)
	-- A serial prevents a late recovery callback from overwriting the next strike.
	s.AttackSerial=(s.AttackSerial or 0)+1; local serial=s.AttackSerial
	local attackToken=tostring(s.Player.UserId)..":"..string.format("%.6f",workspace:GetServerTimeNow())..":"..serial
	local function forestHit(applied,point)
		if applied>0 then
			s.HuntEngagedUntil = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + 25
			s.Player:SetAttribute("HuntingDamage",(s.Player:GetAttribute("HuntingDamage") or 0)+applied)
			remote:FireAllClients("Hit",point,applied,false)
		end
	end
	local windup = s.RestPose * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(100), 0, math.rad(-30))
	if spec.Style=="Thrust" then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,.7)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
	elseif spec.Style=="Spin" or spec.Style=="Sweep" then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(0,-1.4,math.pi/2) end
	if weapon.Ranged then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,.25) end
	TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(spec.Windup), {C0 = windup}):Play()
	task.delay(spec.Windup, function()
		if not alive(s) or s.Character ~= character or states[s.Player] ~= s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
		if weapon.Ranged then
			TweenService:Create(s.Grip,TweenInfo.new(.16),{C0=s.RestPose}):Play()
			local params=RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances={s.Character,pets}
			for i=1,spec.Shots or 1 do
				if i>1 and (spec.ShotInterval or s.InHunting) then task.wait(spec.ShotInterval or .09) end
				if not alive(s) or s.Character~=character or states[s.Player]~=s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
				local origin=Bow.origin(s.Root.Position)
				local target=if s.Aiming and os.clock()-(s.BowTargetAt or 0)<.35 then s.BowTarget else targetPoint
				local shotDirection=Bow.direction(origin,target,direction)
				local angle=math.rad(math.ceil((i-1)/2)*(if i%2==0 then -1 else 1)*(spec.Spread or 4))
				local aim=CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis,angle):VectorToWorldSpace(shotDirection)
				local result=workspace:Raycast(origin,aim*spec.Range,params)
				local endpoint=if result then result.Position else origin+aim*spec.Range
				remote:FireAllClients("Shot",origin,endpoint,boosted and i==1)
				if result then
					if s.InHunting and dinosaurCombat:FromRayHit(result.Instance) then
						local amount=math.floor(attackDamage*(if boosted and i==1 then 1.25 else 1)+.5)
						if dinosaurCombat:CanHit(s.Player,result.Position,spec.Range+2) then
							forestHit(dinosaurCombat:Damage(s.Player,amount,result.Position,attackToken..":arrow:"..i,"Projectile"),result.Position)
						end
					end
					for _,dummy in dummies:GetChildren() do if s.InTraining and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(dummy) then
						hit(s,dummy,math.floor(attackDamage*(if boosted and i==1 then 1.25 else 1)+.5),false); s.LastTarget=dummy; s.TargetUntil=os.clock()+12
						break
					end end
				end
			end
			return
		end
		for n=1,spec.Hits or 1 do
			if n>1 then task.wait(spec.HitInterval or .13) end
			if not alive(s) or s.Character~=character or states[s.Player]~=s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
			local pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-95),0,if n%2==0 then -.4 else .4)
			if spec.Style=="Thrust" then pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,-2)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
			elseif spec.Style=="Spin" or spec.Style=="Sweep" then pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(0,if n%2==0 then -1.5 else 1.5,math.pi/2) end
			TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(.1), {C0=pose}):Play()
			if spec.Style=="Shield" and s.OffGrip then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.1),{C0=s.OffRest*CFrame.new(.4,.3,-1.2)}):Play() end
			if spec.Name then remote:FireAllClients("ComboFX",s.Root.CFrame,spec.Style,spec.Range) end
			if s.OffGrip and s.WeaponId=="DualDaggers" then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.1),{C0=s.OffRest*CFrame.Angles(-1.5,0,if n%2==0 then .4 else -.4)}):Play() end
			if s.InHunting then
				local applied,point=dinosaurCombat:MeleeStrike(s.Player,s.Root.Position+Vector3.new(0,.8,0),direction,
					spec.Range,spec.Arc or .3,attackDamage,attackToken..":melee:"..n)
				if applied>0 then forestHit(applied,point) end
			end
			for _, dummy in dummies:GetChildren() do
				local delta = dummy.Target.Position - s.Root.Position
				local targetFlat = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
				if s.InTraining and delta.Magnitude <= spec.Range and targetFlat.Magnitude > 0 and direction:Dot(targetFlat.Unit) >= (spec.Arc or .3)
					and lineOfSight(s, dummy.Target.Position, dummy) then
					hit(s, dummy, attackDamage, false); s.LastTarget = dummy; s.TargetUntil = now + 12
				end
			end
		end

			Sensitivity=UIS.MouseDeltaSensitivity,MouseIcon=UIS.MouseIconEnabled}

end)

remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(event, a, b, c)
	if event == "BaseTransitOpen" then
  cancelHeld();inputSerial+=1;hub:Close();panel.Visible=false;aiming=false;locked=false
  baseTransit:Open(a)
 elseif event == "Message" then announce(a)
	elseif event == "Jump" and player.Character == a then
		local hum = a:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = a:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
		end
	elseif event=="ChargeStart" then
  if activeCharge and activeCharge.Id==b then activeCharge.Time=a;readyAt=math.huge end
 elseif event=="ChargeStop" then activeCharge=nil;chargeHUD.Visible=false;readyAt=os.clock()
 elseif event=="ChargeRejected" then
  if activeCharge and activeCharge.Id==a then activeCharge=nil;chargeHUD.Visible=false;readyAt=os.clock() end
 elseif event == "Dodge" then
		readyAt=os.clock()+a
	elseif event == "Attack" then
		readyAt=os.clock()+(c or 0)
		if b then announce("COMBO • "..b) end
	elseif event == "ComboFX" then
		if player:GetAttribute("ShowComboFX")==false then return end
		-- Short local trails make the finisher readable without adding collision.
		local color=if b=="Slam" then Color3.fromRGB(255,191,89) else Color3.fromRGB(113,235,214)
		local count=if b=="Thrust" then 1 else 8
		for i=1,count do
			local effect=Instance.new("Part"); effect.Name="ComboTrail"; effect.Anchored=true
			effect.CanCollide=false; effect.CanQuery=false; effect.CanTouch=false; effect.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
			effect.Color=color; effect.Transparency=.25
			if count==1 then effect.Size=Vector3.new(.14,.14,c); effect.CFrame=a*CFrame.new(0,0,-c/2)
			else
				local full=b=="Spin" or b=="Slam"
				local angle=if full then i*math.pi/4 else -math.pi/2+(i-1)*math.pi/7
				effect.Size=Vector3.new(c*.45,.12,.16)
				effect.CFrame=a*CFrame.Angles(0,angle,0)*CFrame.new(0,if b=="Slam" then -2 else 0,-c*.7)
			end
			effect.Parent=workspace
			TweenService:Create(effect,TweenInfo.new(.22),{Transparency=1}):Play(); Debris:AddItem(effect,.24)
		end
	elseif event == "Shot" then
		local distance=(b-a).Magnitude; if distance<.01 then return end
		local arrow=Instance.new("Part"); arrow.Name="TrainingArrow"; arrow.Anchored=true; arrow.CanCollide=false; arrow.CanQuery=false; arrow.CanTouch=false
		arrow.Size=Vector3.new(.1,.1,2.6); arrow.Material=Enum.Material.Neon; arrow.Color=if c then Color3.fromRGB(255,208,91) else Color3.fromRGB(115,255,140)
		arrow.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(a,b); arrow.Parent=workspace
		local flight=math.clamp(distance/260,.06,.8)
		TweenService:Create(arrow,TweenInfo.new(flight,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),{CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(b,b+(b-a))}):Play(); Debris:AddItem(arrow,flight+.12)
	elseif event == "Hit" then
		if player:GetAttribute("ShowDamage")==false then return end
		local anchor = Instance.new("Part"); anchor.Size = Vector3.one; anchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(a + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
		anchor.Transparency = 1; anchor.Anchored = true; anchor.CanCollide = false; anchor.CanQuery = false; anchor.Parent = workspace
		local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui"); billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 50); billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true; billboard.Parent = anchor
		local number = Instance.new("TextLabel"); number.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); number.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		number.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack; number.TextSize = 28
		number.TextColor3 = if c then Color3.fromRGB(88, 230, 172) else Color3.fromRGB(255, 211, 104)
		number.Text = (if c then "Pet " else "") .. b; number.Parent = billboard
		TweenService:Create(anchor, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {Position = anchor.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(number, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play(); Debris:AddItem(anchor, 0.85)
	end
end)

local function menuOpen()
 local economyGUI=player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("HunDinoEconomy")
 local economyPanel=economyGUI and economyGUI:FindFirstChild("Panel")

 local questGUI=player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("HunDinoHuntQuest")

  for _,name in {"QuestBoard","ResultModal"} do

  end
 end

 local picker=forestGUI and forestGUI:FindFirstChild("ZonePicker")
 return panel.Visible or hub:IsOpen() or baseTransit:IsOpen() or (forestGUI and forestGUI.Enabled and picker and picker.Visible) or false

local function aimDirection(ranged, dodge)
	local character = player.Character
	local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local dir = lastDirection
	if ranged and root then
		local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera; local size=camera.ViewportSize
		local ray=camera:ViewportPointToRay(size.X/2,size.Y/2)
		local params=RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local ignored={character}
		local pets=workspace:FindFirstChild("TrainingPets")
		if pets then table.insert(ignored,pets) end
		for _,other in Players:GetPlayers() do if other~=player and other.Character then table.insert(ignored,other.Character) end end
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignored
		local result=workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin,ray.Direction*250,params)
		local target=if result then result.Position else ray.Origin+ray.Direction*250
		return Bow.direction(Bow.origin(root.Position),target,camera.CFrame.LookVector),target
	end
	if (locked or aiming) and not dodge then dir = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
	elseif hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 then dir = hum.MoveDirection
	elseif root then dir = lastDirection end
	dir = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
	return if dir.Magnitude > 0.01 then dir.Unit else Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
end
local function send(action)
 local function dispatch()
  if player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying")==true or menuOpen() or GuiService.MenuIsOpen or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
  local ranged=player:GetAttribute("WeaponId")=="Bow"
  local bowShot=ranged and (action=="Light" or action=="Heavy" or action=="Skill")
  local direction,target=aimDirection(bowShot,action=="Dodge")
  if ranged and action=="Light" then
   if activeCharge or not player:GetAttribute("Drawn") then return end
   chargeId+=1;local token=chargeId
   activeCharge={Id=token,Action=action,Started=os.clock(),Time=Weapons.Bow.Charge.Time}
   remote:FireServer("ChargeStart",{Id=token,Action=action,Direction=direction,Target=target})
   if not held[action] then remote:FireServer("ChargeRelease",{Id=token,Direction=direction,Target=target});activeCharge=nil end
  else remote:FireServer(action,if bowShot then {Direction=direction,Target=target} else direction) end
 end
 inputSerial+=1; local serial=inputSerial; local remaining=readyAt-os.clock()

local function settings(overrides)
	local result = table.clone(Defaults)
	for key, value in overrides or {} do
		if result[key] ~= nil and typeof(result[key]) == typeof(value) then result[key] = value end
	end
	return result
end
local function newPart(folder, name, size, cf, attachTo)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name; part.Size = size; part.CFrame = cf
	part.Transparency = 1; part.CanCollide = false; part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false; part.CastShadow = false; part.Massless = true
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 180, 255)
	part:SetAttribute("CombatHitbox", true)
	part.Parent = folder
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "FollowRig"; weld.Part0 = attachTo; weld.Part1 = part
	weld.C0 = attachTo.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(cf); weld.Parent = part
	return part, weld
end

function Combat.new(model, forest, mapConfig, session, options)
	assert(not owners[model], "Dinosaur already has a combat controller")
	options = options or {}
	local root = assert(model.PrimaryPart, "Dinosaur needs a PrimaryPart")
	local self = setmetatable({
		Model = model, Forest = forest, MapConfig = mapConfig, Session = session,
		Root = root, Settings = settings(options.Settings),
		_health = 0, _state = "Idle", _time = 0, _target = nil, _tokens = {}, _lastHits = {}, _petLastHits = {},
		_attackSequence = 0, _attackHits = 0, _lastAttack = -math.huge,
		_phase = "Idle", _phaseUntil = 0, _lastDamaged = -math.huge,
		_autoConnect = options.AutoConnect ~= false, _running = false, _destroyed = false,
		_original = {}, _hurtboxes = {}, _damagePlayer = options.DamagePlayer, _damagePets = options.DamagePets,
		_blockedFor = 0, _publishElapsed = 0,
	}, Combat)
	assert(finite(self.Settings.MaxHealth) and self.Settings.MaxHealth > 0, "MaxHealth must be positive")
	for _, key in {"Health", "MaxHealth", "CombatState", "CombatTargetUserId", "AttackReady", "AttackSequence", "AttackPhase", "AttackHits", "DinosaurDead", "Weak", "Trapped", "Captured", "TrapUntil", "CapturePoint"} do
		self._original[key] = { value = model:GetAttribute(key) }
	end
	if model:GetAttribute("ShowCombatHitboxes") == nil then model:SetAttribute("ShowCombatHitboxes", false) end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder"); folder.Name = "CombatHitboxes"; folder.Parent = model; self._folder = folder
	-- The lower-leg volumes reach the feet. A player can hit the animal from the
	-- ground rather than having to jump to its 30-stud-high torso.
	for _, definition in {
		{"BodyHurtbox", "body", "body_geom", Vector3.new(.9, .9, .9)},
		{"HeadHurtbox", "head", "head_geom", Vector3.new(.9, .9, .9)},
		{"LeftLegHurtbox", "left leg", "left leg_geom", Vector3.new(.94, .99, .94)},
		{"RightLegHurtbox", "right leg", "right leg_geom", Vector3.new(.94, .99, .94)},
	} do
		local group = assert(model:FindFirstChild(definition[2]), "Missing " .. definition[2])
		local source = assert(group:FindFirstChild(definition[3], true), "Missing " .. definition[3])
		local box = newPart(folder, definition[1], source.Size * definition[4], source.CFrame, source)
		box.CanQuery = true; box:SetAttribute("DinosaurHurtbox", true)
		table.insert(self._hurtboxes, box)
	end
	self._attackBox, self._attackWeld = newPart(folder, "BiteAttackHitbox", self.Settings.BiteHitboxSize, root.CFrame, root)
	self._attackBox:SetAttribute("DinosaurAttackHitbox", true)
	local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.Name = "CombatWarning"; highlight.Adornee = model
	highlight.FillTransparency = .85; highlight.OutlineTransparency = .15
	highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded; highlight.Enabled = false
	highlight.Parent = folder; self._highlight = highlight
	self:_createHealthbar()
	local jawModule = model:FindFirstChild("JawController")
	if jawModule then self._jaw = require(jawModule).new(model) end
	self._debugConnection = model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ShowCombatHitboxes"):Connect(function() self:_showBoxes() end)
	owners[model] = self
	self:Reset()
	return self
end

function Combat:_publish()
	local model = self.Model
	model:SetAttribute("Health", self._health); model:SetAttribute("MaxHealth", self.Settings.MaxHealth)
	model:SetAttribute("CombatState", self._state)
	model:SetAttribute("CombatTargetUserId", if self._target then self._target.UserId else 0)
	model:SetAttribute("AttackPhase", self._phase); model:SetAttribute("AttackSequence", self._attackSequence)
	model:SetAttribute("AttackHits", self._attackHits); model:SetAttribute("DinosaurDead", self._health <= 0)
	model:SetAttribute("Weak", self._health > 0 and self._health <= self.Settings.MaxHealth * .1)
	model:SetAttribute("Trapped", self._trapOwner ~= nil); model:SetAttribute("TrapUntil", self._trapUntil or 0)
	model:SetAttribute("Captured", self._captured == true)
	model:SetAttribute("CapturePoint", self:GetCapturePoint())
	model:SetAttribute("AttackReady", self._health > 0 and not self._captured and not self._trapOwner and self._target ~= nil)
	local ratio = math.clamp(self._health / self.Settings.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
	self._hpText.Text = string.format("T-REX  %d / %d", math.ceil(self._health), self.Settings.MaxHealth)
	self._hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ratio, 1)
	self._hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = if ratio > .5 then Color3.fromRGB(111, 181, 92) elseif ratio > .25 then Color3.fromRGB(232, 181, 71) else Color3.fromRGB(222, 85, 64)
	self._statusText.Text = if self._captured then "ĐÃ BẮT SỐNG" elseif self._health <= 0 then "ĐÃ HẠ"
		elseif self._trapOwner then "MẮC BẪY — ĐẾN TRƯỚC MÕM ĐỂ CHO UỐNG"
		elseif self._health <= self.Settings.MaxHealth * .1 then "ĐÃ YẾU — CÓ THỂ BẮT SỐNG"
		elseif self._phase == "Windup" then "CHUẨN BỊ CẮN — NÉ SANG BÊN!"
		elseif self._target then "ĐANG PHẢN CÔNG" elseif self._state == "Returning" then "QUAY LẠI TUYẾN" else "ĐANG TUẦN TRA / NGHỈ CHÂN"
end
function Combat:_showBoxes()
	local debug = self.Model:GetAttribute("ShowCombatHitboxes") == true
	for _, box in self._hurtboxes do box.Transparency = if debug then .7 else 1 end
	local active = self._phase == "Active"
	self._attackBox.Color = if active then Color3.fromRGB(244, 80, 48) else Color3.fromRGB(255, 177, 55)
	self._attackBox.Transparency = if self._phase == "Windup" then .86 elseif active then .74 elseif debug then .82 else 1
	self._highlight.Enabled = self._phase == "Windup" or active
	self._highlight.FillColor = self._attackBox.Color; self._highlight.OutlineColor = self._attackBox.Color
end
function Combat:_setPhase(phase, duration)
	self._phase = phase; self._phaseUntil = self._time + (duration or 0)
	self:_showBoxes(); self:_publish()
end
function Combat:_patrol() return self.Session and self.Session.Patrol end
function Combat:_character(player)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") or player:GetAttribute("InHunting") ~= true then return nil end
	local questOwner = self.Model:GetAttribute("QuestOwnerUserId")
	if questOwner and (player.UserId ~= questOwner or self.Model:GetAttribute("QuestCombatAllowed") == false) then return nil end
	if player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying")==true then return nil end
	if not self.Session or not self.Session.Players[player] then return nil end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
	local offset = self.MapConfig.WorldOffset or self.Forest:GetAttribute("WorldOffset") or Vector3.zero
	local p = root.Position - offset
	local limitX = (self.MapConfig.MapWidth or self.MapConfig.MapSize or 1620) * .5 + 105
	local limitZ = (self.MapConfig.MapDepth or self.MapConfig.MapSize or 1620) * .5 + 105
	if math.abs(p.X) > limitX or math.abs(p.Z) > limitZ or p.Y < (self.MapConfig.TerrainMin or -48) - 20 or p.Y > (self.MapConfig.TerrainMax or 128) + 120 then return nil end
	local zones = self.Forest:FindFirstChild("Zones")
	local camp = zones and zones:FindFirstChild("Camp")
	local node = camp and camp:FindFirstChild("Node")
	local safeRadius = self.MapConfig.CampSafeRadius or ((camp and camp:GetAttribute("Width") or 180) * .5 + self.Settings.CampMargin)
	if node and (flat(root.Position - node.Position)).Magnitude < safeRadius then return nil end
	return character, humanoid, root
end
function Combat:_lineOfSight(origin, destination, character)
	local delta = destination - origin
	if delta.Magnitude < .01 then return true end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ignored = {self.Model}
	if character then table.insert(ignored, character) end
	local pets = workspace:FindFirstChild("TrainingPets")
	if pets then table.insert(ignored, pets) end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
	params.IgnoreWater = true; params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, delta, params)
	return not hit or hit.Distance >= delta.Magnitude - .35
end
function Combat:GetHurtboxes() return table.clone(self._hurtboxes) end
function Combat:FromRayHit(instance)
	if self._destroyed or self._captured or self._health <= 0 or typeof(instance) ~= "Instance" or not instance:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
	if instance == self._attackBox then return false end
	if instance:GetAttribute("DinosaurHurtbox") == true and instance:IsDescendantOf(self.Model) then return true end
	for _, groupName in {"body", "head", "left leg", "right leg"} do
		local group = self.Model:FindFirstChild(groupName)
		if group and instance:IsDescendantOf(group) then return true end
	end
	return false
end
function Combat:GetAimPoint()
	return self._hurtboxes[1].Position
end
function Combat:GetClosestHitPoint(origin, range, direction, arc)
	if self._destroyed or self._captured or self._health <= 0 or not vector(origin) or not finite(range) or range < 0 then return nil end
	local forward = if vector(direction) and flat(direction).Magnitude > .01 then flat(direction).Unit else nil
	local threshold = if finite(arc) then math.clamp(arc, -1, 1) else -.1
	local best, bestBox, bestDistance = nil, nil, math.min(range, self.Settings.MaxWeaponRange) + .001
	for _, box in self._hurtboxes do
		local point = nearestPoint(box, origin)
		local delta = point - origin
		local horizontal = flat(delta)
		if delta.Magnitude < bestDistance and (not forward or horizontal.Magnitude < .1 or forward:Dot(horizontal.Unit) >= threshold) then
			best, bestBox, bestDistance = point, box, delta.Magnitude
		end
	end
	return best, bestBox
end
function Combat:CanHit(player, point, maxRange)
	if self._destroyed or not self._running then return false, "Inactive" end
	if self._captured then return false, "Captured" end
	if self._health <= 0 then return false, "Dead" end
	local character, _, root = self:_character(player)
	if not character then return false, "NotHunting" end
	if not vector(point) or not finite(maxRange) or maxRange < 0 then return false, "InvalidHit" end
	if (point - root.Position).Magnitude > math.min(maxRange, self.Settings.MaxWeaponRange) + 2.5 then return false, "OutOfRange" end
	local inBox = false
	for _, box in self._hurtboxes do if inside(box, point, 1.5) then inBox = true; break end end
	-- The four query volumes define damageable body, head, and legs. The tail
	-- remains visual rather than silently granting a hit outside these volumes.
	if not inBox then return false, "OutsideHurtbox" end
	if not self:_lineOfSight(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), point, character) then return false, "Obstructed" end
	return true
end
function Combat:MeleeStrike(player, origin, direction, range, arc, damage, token)
	local character, _, root = self:_character(player)
	if not character or not vector(origin) or (origin - root.Position).Magnitude > 6 then return 0, nil, "InvalidOrigin" end
	if not vector(direction) or flat(direction).Magnitude < .01 or not finite(range) or range <= 0 then return 0, nil, "InvalidDirection" end
	local point = self:GetClosestHitPoint(origin, range, direction, arc)
	if not point then return 0, nil, "Miss" end
	local allowed, reason = self:CanHit(player, point, range)
	if not allowed then return 0, nil, reason end
	local applied, damageReason = self:Damage(player, damage, point, token)
	return applied, point, damageReason
end
function Combat:Damage(player, damage, point, token, source)
	local allowed, reason = self:CanHit(player, point, self.Settings.MaxWeaponRange)
	if not allowed then return 0, reason end
	if not finite(damage) or damage <= 0 or damage > self.Settings.MaxDamagePerHit then return 0, "InvalidDamage" end
	if token ~= nil and (type(token) ~= "string" or #token == 0 or #token > 160) then return 0, "InvalidToken" end
	-- A server-owned companion strike must not suppress a simultaneous player hit.
	local hitTimes = if source == "Pet" then self._petLastHits else self._lastHits
	local last = hitTimes[player]
	if last and self._time - last < self.Settings.MinimumHitInterval - .0001 then return 0, "HitCooldown" end
	local tokens = self._tokens[player]
	if not tokens then tokens = {}; self._tokens[player] = tokens end
	if token and tokens[token] and tokens[token] > self._time then return 0, "DuplicateHit" end
	for previous, expires in tokens do if expires <= self._time then tokens[previous] = nil end end
	if token then tokens[token] = self._time + self.Settings.AttackTokenLifetime end
	hitTimes[player] = self._time
	local beforeHP = self._health
	local applied = math.min(self._health, damage)
	self._health -= applied; self._lastDamaged = self._time
	if self._health <= 0 then
		self:ReleaseTrap(self._trapOwner)
		self:_clearTarget("Dead")
		local patrol = self:_patrol(); if patrol then patrol:SetDead(true) end
		self._state = "Dead"
	else
		local patrol = self:_patrol()
		if patrol then
			if self._target ~= player then self:_cancelAttack() end
			if patrol:BeginCombat() ~= false then
				self._target = player; self._state = "Chasing"; self._blockedFor = 0
			end
		end
	end
	self:_publish()
	if self.OnDamage then self.OnDamage(player,beforeHP,self._health) end
	return applied
end
function Combat:_cancelAttack()
	self._attackVictim = nil; self._attackHit = false
	if self._jaw then self._jaw:Cancel() end
	self:_setPhase("Idle")
end
function Combat:_clearTarget(state)
	local wasTarget = self._target ~= nil
	self._target = nil; self._blockedFor = 0
	self:_cancelAttack()
	if wasTarget then local patrol = self:_patrol(); if patrol then patrol:EndCombat() end end
	self._state = state or (if wasTarget then "Returning" else "Idle")
	self:_publish()
end
function Combat:PlayerExited(player)
	self._tokens[player] = nil; self._lastHits[player] = nil; self._petLastHits[player] = nil
	if self._target == player or self._attackVictim == player then self:_clearTarget() end
end
function Combat:_supportAndForward()
	local patrol = self:_patrol()
	local snapshot = patrol and patrol:GetSnapshot()
	local support = snapshot and snapshot.SupportPosition
	if not vector(support) then support = self.Root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 23, 0) end
	local direction = self.Root.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(self.Model:GetAttribute("ForwardInRoot") or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
	direction = flat(direction)
	if direction.Magnitude < .01 then direction = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) else direction = direction.Unit end
	return support, direction, snapshot
end
function Combat:GetSupportPoint()
	local support = self:_supportAndForward()
	return support
end
function Combat:GetCapturePoint()
	local support, direction = self:_supportAndForward()
	local point = support + direction * (self.Settings.BiteForwardOffset + 16)
	local params = RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Terrain, self.Forest}; params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(point + Vector3.new(0, 24, 0), Vector3.new(0, -64, 0), params)
	return if hit and hit.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water and hit.Normal.Y > .6 then hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0) else nil
end
function Combat:TrapFor(runId, untilTime)
	if self._destroyed or self._captured or self._health <= 0 or type(runId) ~= "string"
		or not finite(untilTime) or untilTime <= workspace:GetServerTimeNow() or self._trapOwner then return false end
	self._trapOwner, self._trapUntil = runId, untilTime
	self._trapRouteEnabled = self.Model:GetAttribute("RouteEnabled")
	self.Model:SetAttribute("RouteEnabled", false)
	self:_cancelAttack(); self._state = "Trapped"; self:_publish()
	return true
end
function Combat:ReleaseTrap(runId)
	if not self._trapOwner or (runId ~= nil and runId ~= self._trapOwner) then return false end
	self._trapOwner, self._trapUntil = nil, nil
	self.Model:SetAttribute("RouteEnabled", self._trapRouteEnabled)
	self._trapRouteEnabled = nil
	self._state = if self._target then "Chasing" else "Idle"
	self:_publish(); return true
end
function Combat:Capture(runId, verifiedNow)
	if self._destroyed or self._captured or self._health <= 0 or self._health > self.Settings.MaxHealth * .1
		or self._trapOwner ~= runId or (verifiedNow or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) > (self._trapUntil or 0) then return false end
	self._captured = true; self._captureGeneration = (self._captureGeneration or 0) + 1
	local generation = self._captureGeneration
	self:_clearTarget("Captured"); self:ReleaseTrap(runId); self._state = "Captured"
	local patrol = self:_patrol(); if patrol then patrol:SetDead(true); patrol:Stop() end
	self._captureScale = self.Model:GetScale(); self._captureVisuals = {}
	for _, part in self.Model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then self._captureVisuals[part] = part.Transparency end
	end
	self._gui.Enabled = false; self:_publish()
	task.spawn(function()
		for step = 1, 20 do
			if self._destroyed or not self._captured or self._captureGeneration ~= generation then return end
			local alpha = step / 20
			self.Model:ScaleTo(self._captureScale * (1 - .85 * alpha))
			for part, original in self._captureVisuals do if part.Parent then part.Transparency = original + (1 - original) * alpha end end
			task.wait(.1)
		end
	end)
	return true
end
function Combat:_updateAttackBox()
	local support, direction = self:_supportAndForward()
	local center = support + direction * self.Settings.BiteForwardOffset + Vector3.yAxis * self.Settings.BiteHeightAboveGround
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(center, center + direction)
	self._attackWeld.C0 = self.Root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(cf)
	return support, direction, cf
end
function Combat:_canBite(player)
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_character(player)
	if not character then return false end
	local support, forward, cf = self:_updateAttackBox()
	local offset = flat(root.Position - support)
	if offset.Magnitude > self.Settings.BiteRange or offset.Magnitude < .01 or forward:Dot(offset.Unit) < self.Settings.BiteMinimumFacingDot then return false end
	local localRoot = cf:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
	local half = self.Settings.BiteHitboxSize * .5 + Vector3.new(1.5, 2, 1.5)
	if math.abs(localRoot.X) > half.X or math.abs(localRoot.Y) > half.Y or math.abs(localRoot.Z) > half.Z then return false end
	if not self:_lineOfSight(support + Vector3.yAxis * 7, root.Position, character) then return false end
	local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
	overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}; overlap.RespectCanCollide = false
	local foundBody = false
	for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cf, self.Settings.BiteHitboxSize, overlap) do
		if part == root or part.Parent == character then foundBody = true; break end
	end
	return foundBody, humanoid
end
function Combat:_startAttack()
	self._attackVictim = self._target; self._attackHit = false
	self._attackSequence += 1; self._lastAttack = self._time
	self._state = "Windup"; self:_setPhase("Windup", self.Settings.BiteWindup)
	-- Open the jaw during the warning, then bite once when the active window opens.
	if self._jaw then self._jaw:SetOpenAngle(20) end
end
function Combat:_attackStep()
	if self._phase == "Windup" and self._time >= self._phaseUntil then
		self._state = "Biting"; self:_setPhase("Active", self.Settings.BiteActiveSeconds)
		if self._jaw then task.spawn(function() if not self._destroyed and self._phase == "Active" then self._jaw:Bite() end end) end
	end
	if self._phase == "Active" then
		if not self._attackHit and self._attackVictim == self._target then
			local valid, humanoid = self:_canBite(self._attackVictim)
			if valid then
				self._attackHit = true; self._attackHits += 1
				if self._damagePlayer then self._damagePlayer(self._attackVictim, self.Settings.BiteDamage, self.Model)
				else humanoid:TakeDamage(self.Settings.BiteDamage) end
				self:_publish()
			end
		end
		-- Pets use the same short, server-owned bite volume and sequence. The
		-- companion controller checks its body, line of sight and one hit per bite.
		if self._damagePets and self._phase == "Active" and self._health > 0 then
			self._damagePets(self._attackBox.CFrame, self.Settings.BiteHitboxSize,
				self._attackSequence, self.Settings.BiteDamage, self.Model)
		end
		if self._time >= self._phaseUntil then self._state = "Recovering"; self:_setPhase("Recovery", self.Settings.BiteRecovery) end
	elseif self._phase == "Recovery" and self._time >= self._phaseUntil then
		self._state = "Chasing"; self:_setPhase("Idle")
	end
end
function Combat:Step(dt)
	if not self._running or self._destroyed then return end
	if not finite(dt) or dt <= 0 then return end
	dt = math.min(dt, .2); self._time += dt
	if not self.Model.Parent or not self.Root.Parent then self:Destroy(); return end
	if self._captured then return end
	if self._trapOwner then
		if self._health <= 0 or workspace:GetServerTimeNow() > self._trapUntil then self:ReleaseTrap(self._trapOwner)
		else self._state = "Trapped"; self:_publish(); return end
	end
	self:_updateAttackBox()
	if self._target and self._health > 0 then
		local character, _, targetRoot = self:_character(self._target)
		local support, _, snapshot = self:_supportAndForward()
		local patrol = self:_patrol()
		local anchor = snapshot and snapshot.PatrolAnchor
		local leashed = vector(anchor) and targetRoot and flat(targetRoot.Position - anchor).Magnitude > self.Settings.LeashDistance
		if not character or not patrol or leashed or self._time - self._lastDamaged > self.Settings.AggroTimeout then self:_clearTarget()
		else
			self._blockedFor = if snapshot and snapshot.CombatBlocked then self._blockedFor + dt else 0
			if self._blockedFor >= self.Settings.BlockedTimeout then self:_clearTarget()
			elseif self._phase ~= "Idle" then

		LastDamageAt = 0,
	}

	if not validMemory(memory) or not validTime(now) then return false end

	local nextPosition = self:_segment(from, from + direction.Unit * distance, params)
	if not nextPosition then
		if self._waypoints then self:_clearPath() end
		self:_requestPath(goal, now)
		self:_moving(false)
		return false
	end
	self.Pet:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(nextPosition, nextPosition + direction.Unit))
	self:_moving(true)
	return true
end
function Controller:_face(point)
	local origin = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position
	local direction = flat(point - origin)
	if direction.Magnitude > .01 then self.Pet:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + direction.Unit)) end
end
function Controller:_lineOfSight(origin, point, target)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {self.Character, self.PetFolder or self.Pet}
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	params.IgnoreWater = false
	local delta = point - origin
	if delta.Magnitude < .01 then return true end
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, delta, params)
	return not hit or hit.Distance >= delta.Magnitude - .35 or (target and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target))
end
function Controller:_attackAllowed(now)
	return self:_canAct() and self:_hunting() and self.IsEngaged() == true and not self:_stunned(now)
		and not self._healing and (self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position - self.Root.Position).Magnitude <= CHASE_LIMIT
end
function Controller:_attackPoint(range)
	local center = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + BODY_OFFSET
	local point = self.Combat:GetClosestHitPoint(center, range)
	if not point or (point - self.Root.Position).Magnitude > CHASE_LIMIT then return nil end
	return point
end
function Controller:_startAttack(now)
	if self._attack or self.Animator:IsAttacking() or not self:_attackAllowed(now)
		or not self.Rules.canAttack(self.Memory, now) then return end
	local point = self:_attackPoint(self.Rules.Config.AttackRange)
	local center = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + BODY_OFFSET
	if not point or not self:_lineOfSight(center, point, self.Combat.Model) then return end
	local count = self.Animator:GetHitCount()
	if count < 1 then return end
	self._attackSerial += 1
	local serial = self._attackSerial
	local attack = {Serial = serial, HitCount = count, Fired = {},
		TokenPrefix = string.format("pet:%d:%.6f:%d", self.Player.UserId, now, serial)}
	self._attack = attack
	self.Animator.OnHit = function(index)
		if self._destroyed or self._attack ~= attack or serial ~= self._attackSerial or attack.Fired[index] then return end
		attack.Fired[index] = true
		local hitNow = self:_now()
		if not self:_attackAllowed(hitNow) then return end
		local hitPoint = self:_attackPoint(self.Rules.Config.AttackRange)
		local origin = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + BODY_OFFSET
		if not hitPoint or not self:_lineOfSight(origin, hitPoint, self.Combat.Model) then return end
		-- Dual daggers have two animation marks but still deal one 12-damage total.
		local total = self.Rules.Config.AttackDamage
		local amount = math.floor(total / count) + (if index <= total % count then 1 else 0)
		local token = string.format("%s:%d", attack.TokenPrefix, index)
		local applied = self.Combat:Damage(self.Player, amount, hitPoint, token, "Pet")
		if applied > 0 then
			if self.OnDamage then self.OnDamage(applied, hitPoint) end
			if self.Remote then
				self.Remote:FireAllClients("Hit", hitPoint, applied, true)
				if self.Pet:GetAttribute("PetWeaponId") == "Bow" then self.Remote:FireAllClients("Shot", origin, hitPoint, false) end
			end
		end
	end
	self:_face(point)
	if self.Animator:Attack() then
		self.Rules.beginAttack(self.Memory, now)
		setAttribute(self.Pet, "PetAttackStarted", now)
		setAttribute(self.Pet, "PetAttackSequence", (self.Pet:GetAttribute("PetAttackSequence") or 0) + 1)
		self:_moving(false)
		self:_setState("Attacking")
	else
		self._attack = nil
		self.Animator.OnHit = nil
	end
end

function Controller:_updateMedicine(now)
	if not self._medicineOrb then
		local orb = Instance.new("Part")
		orb.Name = "PetMedicineOrb"
		orb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		orb.Size = Vector3.new(1.05, 1.05, 1.05)
		orb.Color = Color3.fromRGB(98, 255, 135)
		orb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		orb.Anchored = true
		orb.CanCollide, orb.CanTouch, orb.CanQuery = false, false, false
		orb.Parent = self.Pet
		self._medicineOrb = orb
	end
	local carried = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(1.2, 2.4, -.2))
	local healing = self._healing
	if healing and healing.StartedAt then
		local t = math.clamp((now - healing.StartedAt) / self.Rules.Config.HealCastSeconds, 0, 1)
		local destination = self.Root.Position + Vector3.new(0, .2, 0)
		carried = carried:Lerp(destination, t) + UP * math.sin(t * math.pi) * 1.8
	end
	self._medicineOrb.Position = carried
end
function Controller:RequestHeal(now)
	if self._destroyed then return false, "Unavailable" end
	now = now or self:_now()
	self.Rules.tick(self.Memory, now)
	if not self:_canAct() then return false, "Unavailable" end
	if self._healing then return false, "Healing" end
	local allowed, reason = self.Rules.canHeal(self.Memory, now, self.Humanoid.Health, self.Humanoid.MaxHealth)
	if not allowed then self:_publish(); return false, reason end
	self:_clearAttack()
	self:_clearPath()
	self._healing = {RequestedAt = now}
	self:_updateMedicine(now)
	self:_setState("HealApproach")
	return true
end
function Controller:_stepHeal(now, dt)
	local healing = self._healing
	if not healing then return false end
	local allowed = self.Rules.canHeal(self.Memory, now, self.Humanoid.Health, self.Humanoid.MaxHealth)
	if not self:_canAct() or self:_stunned(now) or not allowed or now - healing.RequestedAt > 12 then
		self:Cancel("HealInterrupted")
		return false
	end
	local center = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + BODY_OFFSET
	local ownerPoint = self.Root.Position
	local distance = (center - ownerPoint).Magnitude
	local visible = self:_lineOfSight(center, ownerPoint, self.Character)
	if distance > self.Rules.Config.HealRange or not visible then
		healing.StartedAt, healing.FinishAt = nil, nil
		local desired = self.Root.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(2.4, 0, 1))
		self:_walk(desired, now, dt, .25)
		self:_setState("HealApproach")
	elseif not healing.StartedAt then
		healing.StartedAt, healing.FinishAt = now, now + self.Rules.Config.HealCastSeconds
		self:_moving(false)
		self:_face(ownerPoint)
		self:_setState("Healing")
	elseif now >= healing.FinishAt then
		-- Recheck owner life/range/LOS at the commit frame; the cooldown begins
		-- only after a real heal, never merely for requesting or interrupting one.
		local currentHealth = self.Humanoid.Health
		local amount = self.Rules.commitHeal(self.Memory, now, currentHealth, self.Humanoid.MaxHealth)
		if amount > 0 then self.Humanoid.Health = math.min(self.Humanoid.MaxHealth, currentHealth + amount) end
		self._healing = nil
		self:_clearMedicine()
		self:_setState("Following")
		return true
	end
	self:_updateMedicine(now)
	self:_publish()
	return true
end

function Controller:Damage(amount, now)
	if self._destroyed or not self:_canAct() then return 0 end
	now = now or self:_now()
	local applied = self.Rules.damage(self.Memory, amount, now)
	if applied > 0 then
		if self:_stunned(now) then self:Cancel("Stunned"); self:_setState("Stunned") end
		self:_publish()
	end
	return applied
end
function Controller:DamageInBite(cf, size, sequence, damage, sourceModel, now)
	if not self:_canAct() or not self:_hunting() or not finite(damage) or damage <= 0
		or typeof(cf) ~= "CFrame" or not vector(size) or size.X <= 0 or size.Y <= 0 or size.Z <= 0
		or (type(sequence) ~= "number" and type(sequence) ~= "string") then return 0 end
	now = now or self:_now()
	local sourceKey = sourceModel or self.Combat.Model
	local token = self._biteTokens[sourceKey]
	if token and token.Sequence == sequence then return 0 end
	local center = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + BODY_OFFSET
	local localPoint = cf:PointToObjectSpace(center)
	if math.abs(localPoint.X) > size.X * .5 or math.abs(localPoint.Y) > size.Y * .5
		or math.abs(localPoint.Z) > size.Z * .5 then return 0 end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ignored = {self.Character, self.PetFolder or self.Pet}
	if sourceKey then table.insert(ignored, sourceKey) end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	params.IgnoreWater = false
	local delta = center - cf.Position
	local obstruction = workspace:Raycast(cf.Position, delta, params)
	if obstruction and obstruction.Distance < delta.Magnitude - .2 then return 0 end
	self._biteTokens[sourceKey] = {Sequence = sequence, At = now}
	for model, entry in self._biteTokens do if now - entry.At > 60 then self._biteTokens[model] = nil end end
	return self:Damage(damage, now)
end

-- The old training dummy follower remains authoritative when this returns false.
-- Animator:Update is still called once by Training.server after either mover.
function Controller:Step(now, dt)
	if self._destroyed then return false end
	now = now or self:_now()
	self.Rules.tick(self.Memory, now)
	if not self:_canAct() then
		local handled = self:_hunting() or self.Player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") == true
			or self:_stunned(now) or self._healing ~= nil or not self:_alive()
		if self._attack or self._healing or self._waypoints then self:Cancel("Inactive") end
		self:_moving(false)
		self:_setState(if self:_stunned(now) then "Stunned" elseif handled then "Waiting" else "Following")
		return handled
	end
	if self:_stunned(now) then
		if self._attack or self._healing then self:Cancel("Stunned") end
		self:_moving(false)
		self:_setState("Stunned")
		return true
	end
	if self:_stepHeal(now, dt) then return true end
	if not self:_hunting() then
		if self._attack then self:_clearAttack() end
		if self._waypoints then self:_clearPath() end
		self:_setState("Following")
		return false
	end
	if self._attack then
		if not self:_attackAllowed(now) then self:_clearAttack()
		elseif not self.Animator:IsAttacking() then self._attack = nil; self.Animator.OnHit = nil
		else self:_moving(false); self:_setState("Attacking"); return true end
	end
	local engaged = self:_attackAllowed(now)
	local point = if engaged then self:_attackPoint(CHASE_LIMIT) else nil
	if point then
		local center = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + BODY_OFFSET
		if (point - center).Magnitude <= self.Rules.Config.AttackRange and self:_lineOfSight(center, point, self.Combat.Model) then
			self:_moving(false)
			self:_face(point)
			self:_startAttack(now)
			if not self._attack then self:_setState("Following") end
		else
			self:_walk(point, now, dt, 2.8)
			self:_setState("Following")
		end
	else
		self:_walk(self.Root.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(3, 0, 4)), now, dt, 1)
		self:_setState("Following")
	end
	self:_publish()
	return true
end
function Controller:GetSnapshot()
	return {
		Health = self.Memory.Health,
		MaxHealth = self.Rules.Config.MaxHealth,
		State = self._state,
		StunnedUntil = self.Memory.StunnedUntil or 0,
		HealReadyAt = self.Memory.HealReadyAt or 0,
		NextAttackAt = self.Memory.NextAttackAt or 0,
		Healing = self._healing ~= nil,
		HealingUntil = if self._healing then self._healing.FinishAt or 0 else 0,
		Position = if self.Pet.PrimaryPart then self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position else nil,
		AttackSerial = self._attackSerial,
		PathPending = self._pathPending,
		PathFollowing = self._waypoints ~= nil,
		Destroyed = self._destroyed,
	}
end
function Controller:Destroy()
	if self._destroyed then return end
	self:Cancel("Destroyed")
	self._destroyed = true
	table.clear(self._biteTokens)
end

return Controller
